title: WHAT?! (JonTron)
blurb: Full-body disbelief compressed into a single syllable, and one of the most-quoted reactions ever produced on YouTube. What makes it land is that the delivery contains an entire argument — the incredulity is doing the work that a paragraph of rebuttal would otherwise have to. Play it at statements that break the laws of logic: impossible excuses, cursed food combinations, plot holes discovered in real life rather than in fiction. When something defies explanation, this clip demands one anyway and refuses to move on until it gets one.
